ruleset.name: openui-java-pmd
ruleset.description: Huawei Java rules that need type resolution. Checkstyle keeps the purely syntactic rules.

rule.name: LocalVariableShadowsField
rule.message: G.OBJ.04: local variable shadows a field with the same name
rule.description: A local variable that reuses a field name hides the field and invites wrong references. The query compares names against fields declared directly in every enclosing class.

property.name: xpath
property.value: //VariableId[ (ancestor::LocalVariableDeclaration or ancestor::ForeachStatement or ancestor::CatchParameter or ancestor::Resource or ancestor::LambdaParameter) and @Name = ancestor::ClassDeclaration /ClassBody /FieldDeclaration /VariableDeclarator /VariableId /@Name ]

rule.name: MissingNumericSuffix
rule.message: G.FMT.20: numeric literal is missing its type suffix
rule.description: A numeric literal converted to long needs an L suffix; one converted to float needs an F suffix. The rule reads PMD's conversion context, so it covers variable initializers, assignments, return values, invocation arguments, and array values.
